sentir.metaDescription: Fourteen cards to take a slow look at how you are. At the end, an article, an exercise and an invitation to your emotional diary. Evidence-based psychology, no diagnosis.
sentir.heroLeadFirst: A deck of cards to keep you company for a few minutes.
sentir.heroLeadSecond: Not a test, not a diagnosis. A slow mirror.
sentir.introStep1Body: Each card is an inner experience. Read it slowly.
sentir.introStep2Body: Swipe ✗ if not yours, ✓ if it is, ↑ if it hits close.
sentir.introStep3Body: When you finish we offer you an article, an exercise and a feeling to return to.
sentir.introPrivacy: Your answers never leave the browser. No trackers, no accounts.
sentir.deckSwipeHint: You can also swipe the card
sentir.resultBalanceLead: How your answers spread across the six regions of the editorial system.
sentir.resultArticleTitle: An article to keep you company
sentir.resultArticleEmpty: No article archived yet for this region. Come back soon.
sentir.resultExerciseTitle: Something concrete you can do today
sentir.resultDiaryTitle: Write down how this deck left you
sentir.resultDiaryBody: Three minutes in the diary so this reading doesn't stay only in your head.
sentir.endNote: This is no substitute for a session. If it's been like this for a while, write to us.
